r: I would like to see your wares.

sullengard_zaccheria_10.m: I would like to show you, but my inventory has been stolen.
r: Stolen? How? That is extremely unfortunate for you as I have lots of gold to spend.

sullengard_zaccheria_100.m:
Well that's unfortunate that we cannot punish this individual. But very fortunate that you worked hard to recover my items and I am very grateful for that. So grateful in fact, here is {15000} gold for your hard work.
Also, I am now able to trade with you if you like.

sullengard_zaccheria_20.m: [With a smirk] Gee, how fortunate for you that I have job for you if you want it.

sullengard_zaccheria_30.m: I need you to ask around town to see if anyone knows where my supply is or if they have seen anything.
r: I'll take it, but can you give me some more details?

sullengard_zaccheria_40.m: Sure. You see, I was at the tavern last night enjoying a couple "Southernhaze" beers like I almost always do after work, when someone or some people broke into my shop and stole my entire inventory.
r: I see. Anything else? Is there anyone in town that you can think of that would want to hurt you?

sullengard_zaccheria_50.m: Well, let me think...ah yes. Gaelian from the Briwerra family.

sullengard_zaccheria_60.m: Oh, it's not a big deal. Well, not from my side anyway, but he is mad about what he perceives as bad service on some repair work that I had recently done for him. He asked for his gold back, I refused.

sullengard_zaccheria_70.m: Anyways, I think you should start there, but I suspect others too.

sullengard_zaccheria_80.m: Are you carrying what I think you are carrying?
r: Yes. I tracked them down to this lost traveler who recently came into town. He was desperate for gold and a place to rest.

sullengard_zaccheria_85.m: Have you found my stuff yet?
r: Nope. Sorry, I am still looking.

sullengard_zaccheria_90.m: And where is this person now?
r: I wish I knew. After he told me where to find your stuff, he took off and I was unable to see in what direction he fled. Here is your inventory.

I wish I knew. After he told me where to find your stuff, he took off and I was unable to see in what direction he fled. I just remembered that I didn't bring your inventory with me. I'll be right back.

sullengard_zaccheria_ask_about_lt.m: Hey, you are just the person that I wanted to see. I've been wondering that with all of your adventures, have you encountered "the lost traveler" again?

sullengard_zaccheria_ask_about_lt_10.m: Where? Can you get him back here to be punished?
r: Actually, he is in a Fallhaven jail. Locked up with Defy in fact. I was able to capture them and lock them up there.
Actually, I had a chance encounter with him and after attempting to drag him back here, he attacked me and I had no other option than to end his life.
Of course. It was my pleasure.

sullengard_zaccheria_ask_about_lt_12.m: Well, I would have preferred to see him punished instead of killed, but thank you so much for putting an end to all this.
r: Of course. It was my pleasure.

sullengard_zaccheria_ask_about_lt_13.m: Please, take this as a gift of gratitude.

sullengard_zaccheria_ask_about_lt_14.m: I don't know if you will like it, but let me tell you, nobody down here wants it.
r: Oh, really? I will play with it. Thanks again.

sullengard_zaccheria_sell_0.m: How can I be of service?
